arguments.text: Fixed. `dayjs.tz(input, tz)` now detects non-string input (Date, timestamp, Day.js object) and treats it as an instant, delegating to the instance `tz()` conversion instead of re-interpreting the instant as a wall clock in the target zone. `dayjs.tz(new Date('2020-08-07T12:00-07:00'), 'America/Vancouver').format()` now returns `2020-08-07T12:00:00-07:00` (and `.valueOf()` is unchanged), matching moment-timezone; string input behavior is untouched. (src/plugin/timezone/index.js)

Fixed. The instance `tz()` conversion derived its offset from a `toLocaleString` round-trip that drops the fractional second, leaving a fractional offset (e.g. 539.9957 min → `+08:59.9956...`). The difference is now rounded to whole minutes and the milliseconds are carried over explicitly, so `dayjs('2020-08-06T03:48:10.258Z').tz('Asia/Tokyo').format('Z')` returns `+09:00`, `utcOffset()` is `540`, and `valueOf()` stays exactly `1596685690258`. (src/plugin/timezone/index.js)

Fixed. The Dutch locale's `ordinal` always appended a period; it now picks the correct suffix (`ste` for 1, 8 and 20+, `de` otherwise) and bracket-escapes it so `format` doesn't re-scan the suffix as tokens (as the `sv`/`en-gb` locales do). `dayjs('2018-05-08').locale('nl').format('Do')` → `8ste`, `19de`, `1ste`, `20ste`, `2de`; verified identical to moment's `nl` locale for all days 1–31. (src/locale/nl.js)

arguments.text: Fixed. `weekYear()` only handled the "week 1 in December → next year" case; it now also handles the mirror case of the first days of January belonging to the last week (52/53) of the previous year. `dayjs('2021-01-01').locale('en-gb').weekYear()` → 2020 (same for Jan 2/3), `2021-01-04` → 2021. Verified equal to moment's `weekYear()` for every date from 2015–2026 under both `en` and `en-gb`. (src/plugin/weekYear/index.js)

Fixed. The `A`/`a` tokens were matched with a hard-coded `/[AP]M/` regex, so a locale-specific meridiem (zh-cn's 凌晨/早上/上午/中午/下午/晚上) never matched and parsing fell through to `Invalid Date`. `A`/`a` now match a word and resolve it through the locale's `meridiem()` function (falling back to the plain `PM`/`pm` comparison for locales without one), so the round-trip `dayjs(dayjs('2018-05-02 01:02:03').locale('zh-cn').format('YYYY年M月D日Ah点mm分ss秒'), 'YYYY年M月D日Ah点mm分ss秒', 'zh-cn')` gives `2018-05-02 01:02:03`, matching moment for all 24 hours. (src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js)

Fixed. The duration plugin's `unitToMS` table had no entry for milliseconds, so `dayjs.duration(1, 'ms')` multiplied by `undefined` → NaN → an empty duration. Added `milliseconds: 1`, so `dayjs.duration(1, 'ms').toISOString()` → `PT0.001S`, `dayjs.duration(1500, 'ms').asMilliseconds()` → 1500, and `'ms'`/`'millisecond'`/`'milliseconds'` all work (also in `.add`/`.get`). (src/plugin/duration/index.js)
